_comment: Application preferences, declared with exactly the parameter schema used by
every plugin's filters.json (see docs/design/adding_a_filter.md). The same
ParameterFormBuilder that renders the filter panel renders this dialog, so a
new preference needs no UI code at all - only an entry here and a reader.
Only put a constant here if a user could sensibly want it different. Values
that must be derived from the data (a ray epsilon, a bounding-box tolerance)
belong in the algorithm; per-invocation algorithm knobs belong in the owning
filter's filters.json; structural constants (buffer strides, UBO offsets) are

parameters.label: Field of view
parameters.help: Vertical field of view of the perspective camera, in degrees. Lower values flatten perspective, higher values exaggerate it.

parameters.label: Near clip ratio
parameters.help: Near clipping plane as a fraction of the scene radius. Raise it if depth precision looks poor; lower it if geometry close to the camera gets cut away.

parameters.label: Axis gizmo size
parameters.help: Edge length in pixels of the orientation gizmo drawn in the corner of the 3D view.

parameters.label: Drag threshold
parameters.help: How far the pointer must move, in pixels, before a press becomes a drag rather than a click.

parameters.label: Wireframe on load up to
parameters.help: Newly loaded meshes show their wireframe when they have fewer faces than this. Above it the wireframe is off, since it degenerates into a grey smear and costs draw time. Faces.

parameters.label: Flat shading up to
parameters.help: Newly loaded meshes use flat shading when they have fewer faces than this, so the tessellation stays visible; above it they use smooth shading. Independent of the wireframe threshold. Faces.

parameters.label: Default color map
parameters.help: Color map selected when a scalar field is first displayed.

parameters.label: Histogram bins
parameters.help: Number of bins in the scalar histogram overlay.

parameters.label: Recent files
parameters.help: How many entries the recent-meshes menu keeps.

parameters.label: Ray-tracing progress chunks
parameters.help: How many chunks the face array is split into when ray-tracing filters report progress. Higher values update the progress bar and respond to Cancel more often, at a small synchronisation cost.
